notes: A planning thread that wrote its plan and then ended its turn on a background wait reads "Plan ready" again, not "Watching". Since v184 a thread whose turn ends with a live Monitor, cron or run_in_background Bash settles as `watching` instead of idle; usePlanReady only peeked the plan file of idle planning threads, and TabIndicator rendered the watching branch before the planReady one, so such a thread (wbfyQ3CBizDX today, 87 KB plan written, then a re-armed gate wait) lost its violet label until the wait cleared. usePlanReady now counts idle OR watching planning threads with a plan path (isSettledPlanning), and TabIndicator renders Plan ready ahead of Watching, with the wait's description on hover; running, paused, waiting and error still win, and a watching thread with no plan, or a non-planning one, still reads Watching. The strip and header models already keep a watching or plan-ready root live, so no classification changed. Tests: TabIndicator.dom.test.tsx (watching + plan → Plan ready with the wait as title; watching without plan, and watching non-planning → Watching; busier statuses outrank the plan), usePlanReady.dom.test.tsx (a watching planning thread's plan is peeked, a running or non-planning one is not), threadStripModel.test.ts (watching and plan-ready-while-watching roots stay live).
